realm_trial_finish.name: realm_trial_finish
realm_trial_finish.value: ("realm_trials"."state" = 'active' AND "realm_trials"."finished_at" IS NULL AND "realm_trials"."finish_reason" IS NULL) OR ("realm_trials"."state" != 'active' AND "realm_trials"."finished_at" >= "realm_trials"."started_at" AND length("realm_trials"."finish_reason") BETWEEN 1 AND 500)

revalidation_shas.name: revalidation_shas
revalidation_shas.value: length("result_revalidations"."head_sha") = 40 AND "result_revalidations"."head_sha" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND length("result_revalidations"."validator_base_commit") = 40 AND "result_revalidations"."validator_base_commit" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND length("result_revalidations"."integrated_commit") = 40 AND "result_revalidations"."integrated_commit" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND length("result_revalidations"."artifact_sha256") = 64 AND "result_revalidations"."artifact_sha256" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'

stable_settlement_rewards.name: stable_settlement_rewards
stable_settlement_rewards.value: "stable_reward_settlements"."token" >= 0 AND "stable_reward_settlements"."cultivation" >= 0 AND "stable_reward_settlements"."merit" >= 0 AND "stable_reward_settlements"."reviewed_by" != "stable_reward_settlements"."cultivator_id" AND length("stable_reward_settlements"."review_reason") BETWEEN 20 AND 500
